name: Commerce Chase
description: A Drupal Commerce onsite payment gateway that collects cards through Chase Orbital's Hosted Payment Form (tokenized) and charges/captures/voids them via the Orbital SOAP (Paymentech) gateway.
project_description:
Integration for Drupal Commerce and Chase Paymentech. Currently supported is the Orbital Payment Gateway through a submodule in the project. 

 D8 version 
 The D8 version adds an onsite payment gateway. It operates by combining the Hosted Payment Form of Orbital Chase with their SOAP API. 

 The implementation assumes that the merchant has an IP-based SOAP authentication, so there's no username/password required. (Patches are welcome for username/password based authentication support.)
